expectations.text: Raises the licensing question before vendoring
Reads ODbL as permitting redistribution with share-alike, not as a blocker
Notes the MIT conflict / derived-database obligation
If bundling: obligations satisfied and the change of terms surfaced; else: lawful alternative named
Evaluates an alternative source rather than taking OSM as given
Notes Sto. Domingo / Zona no delimitada stay unresolvable
Runs and reports the quality gate
